sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pageGetaddress:
getaddress

Returns an existing default Minima address to receive funds, use as a change address etc.

Each address can be used securely 262144 (64^3) times.

Then you can wipe the private keys from your online node using the 'vault' command.

Examples:

getaddress
sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pageKeys:
keys

Get a list of all your public keys or create a new key.

Each public key can be used for signing securely 262144 (64^3) times.

action: (optional)
    list : List your existing public keys. The default.
    checkkeys : Checks if your Public and Private keys are correct.
    new : Create a new key pair that is stored and managed in your DB.
    genkey : Generate a new key NOT stored in the DB.
    createallkeys : Create all your default wallet keys now, in the background, with keyuses: previous uses.

publickey: (optional)
    Search for a specific public key.

phrase: (optional)
    Use with action:genkey. The seed phrase to derive the key from. If omitted a new
    random phrase is generated and returned.

modifier: (optional)
    Use with action:list. Only show the keys with this modifier.

keyuses: (optional)
    Use with action:createallkeys. The number of previous uses to set on every key.

Examples:

keys

keys action:list

keys action:genkey

keys action:checkkeys

keys action:list publickey:0xFFEE56..

keys action:new

keys action:genkey phrase:"SPRAY LAMP.."

keys action:createallkeys keyuses:1000
sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pageTxninput:
txninput

Add a coin as an input to a transaction.

Optionally specify address, amount and tokenid to use an unspecified coinid - a floating ELTOO coin.

A floating coin can be attached to multiple different existing coins as long as it has the same

address, amount and tokenid - but different coinid.

id:
    The id of the transaction to add an input to.

coinid: (optional)
    The id of the coin to add as an input.

coindata: (optional)
    The data of the coin to add, instead of coinid.
    Can be from the 'coinexport' command or 'outputcoindata' from another transaction.

floating: (optional)
    true or false, true will add an unspecified, floating ELTOO coin as an input.
    If true, also specify address, amount, tokenid.
    If false, specify a coinid or coindata.

address: (optional)
    Coin address to use for the floating input. Can be 0x or Mx address.
    The coin that is used 
amount: (optional)
    Amount of a coin for the floating input.

tokenid: (optional)
    tokenid of a coin for the floating input.

scriptmmr: (optional)
    true or false, true will add the scripts and MMR proof for the coin.

Examples:

txninput id:simpletxn coinid:0xD0BF..

txninput id:multisig coinid:0xD0BF.. scriptmmr:true

txninput id:posttxn coindata:0x000..

txninput id:eltootxn floating:true address:0xFED5.. amount:10 tokenid:0x00
sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pageTxnsign:
txnsign

Sign a transaction.

Specify the public key or use 'auto' if the coin inputs are simple.

id:
    The id of the transaction to sign.

publickey:
    The public key specified in a custom script, or 'auto' for transactions with simple inputs.
    custom : sign with the privatekey: and keyuses: you supply.

txnpostauto: (optional)
    Do you want to post this transaction. Use the same values as you would for txnpost auto(sort MMR and Scripts)

txnpostburn: (optional)
    If you also post this transaction, do you want to add a burn transaction.

txnpostmine: (optional)
    If you also post this transaction, do you want to mine it immediately.

txndelete: (optional)
    true or false - delete this txn after signing AND posting.

password: (optional)
    If your wallet is password locked, unlock it for this signing and relock it afterwards.

privatekey: (optional)
    Use with publickey:custom. The 0x private key seed to sign with.

keyuses: (optional)
    Use with publickey:custom. How many times this private key has already signed. Every signature must use a
    fresh leaf of the key tree, so increase this by one for each signature you make.

Examples:

txnsign id:simpletxn publickey:auto

txnsign id:simpletxn publickey:auto password:your_password

txnsign id:multisig publickey:0xFD8B..

txnsign id:simpletxn publickey:auto txnpostauto:true

txnsign id:multisig publickey:custom privatekey:0x.. keyuses:5

sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pageReset:
reset

Reset your node in various ways. You MUST wait until all your original keys are created before this is allowed.

archivefile:
    Specify the the archive gzip file. Should be recently exported from an archive node.

action:
    chainsync: Re-sync all blocks from the archivefile to get back onto the right chain.
               Seed phrase is not required, the private keys will remain unchanged.
    seedsync: Wipe the wallet and re-generate your keys from your seed phrase. Your coins will be restored.
    restore: Restore a backup and re-sync the entire chain from the archivefile.

file:
    Specify the filename or local path of the backup to restore

password: (optional)
    Enter the password of the backup 

phrase: (optional)
    Your 24 word seed phrase in double quotes. Use with 'action:seedsync'.

keys: (optional)
    Number of keys to create if you need to do a seed re-sync. Default is 64. Use with 'action:seedsync'.

keyuses: (optional)
    How many times at most you used your keys. Use with 'action:seedsync'.
    Every time you re-sync with seed phrase this needs to be higher as Minima Signatures are stateful.
    Defaults to 1000 - the max is 262144 for normal keys.

Examples:

reset archivefile:archiveexport-jul23.gz action:chainsync

reset archivefile:archiveexport-jul23.gz action:seedsync keyuses:1000 phrase:"ENTER 24 WORDS HERE"

reset archivefile:archiveexport-jul23.gz action:restore file:backup-jul23.bak password:Longsecurepassword456
sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.paramResetKeyuses: How many times at most you used your keys. Use with 'action:seedsync'.
sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pageVault:
vault

BE CAREFUL. Wipe / Restore your private keys.

View your passphrase and seed. DO NOT SHARE THESE WITH ANYONE.

ENSURE YOU HAVE A BACKUP AND SECURE RECORD OF YOUR PASSPHRASE BEFORE LOCKING.

You must have your passphrase to unlock your private keys.

action: (optional)
    seed : Show your seed phrase. The default. 
    wipekeys : Wipe your private keys - keep the public.
    restorekeys : Restore your private keys.
    passwordlock : Lock your node by password encrypting private keys.
    passwordunlock : Unlock your node to reinstating your private keys.
    testphrase : Derive the seed and the first numkeys public keys / addresses from a phrase, to check it. Does not touch your wallet.
    resetkeys : BE CAREFUL. Wipe the chain, TxPoW and wallet databases and regenerate every key from the phrase (with keyuses: previous uses).

seed: (optional)
    Enter your seed to lock your node.
    This will delete your private keys.

phrase: (optional)
    Enter your passphrase in double quotes to restore your node.
    This will reinstate your private keys.

keyuses: (optional)
    Use with action:resetkeys. The number of previous uses to assume for every key.
    Default 100.

password: (optional)
    Use with action:passwordlock or action:passwordunlock. The password that
    encrypts / decrypts your private keys. It cannot contain ;

confirm: (optional)
    Use with action:passwordlock. Must match password: exactly or the lock is refused.

numkeys: (optional)
    Use with action:testphrase. How many keys and addresses to derive from the
    phrase. Default 4.

Examples:

vault

vault action:wipekeys seed:0xDD4E..

vault action:restorekeys phrase:"SPRAY LAMP.."

vault action:passwordlock password:your_password

vault action:passwordlock password:your_password confirm:your_password

vault action:passwordunlock password:your_password

vault action:testphrase phrase:"SPRAY LAMP.." numkeys:8

vault action:resetkeys phrase:"SPRAY LAMP.." keyuses:1000

restoresync

Restore your node from a backup and then sync to the top block using an archive node.

You MUST wait until all the keys for the node are created before this is allowed.

Reverts to a standard restore if backup is not older than 2 days.

    Specify the filename or local path of the backup to restore

password: (optional)

keyuses: (optional) 
    Increment (not set) the number of key uses per key.

Examples:

sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pagePrintmmr:
printmmr

Print the MMR set of the tip block and the total number of entries in the MMR.

Returns the tip block number, latest entrynumber and latest set of MMR entries.
For each entry, details of its row, entry number, data and value of all new and updated MMR entries for the tip block.

Row 1 represents the leaf nodes, entry 0 represents the first entry on a row.

Examples:

printmmr

targetdifficulty: (optional)

benchmark hashes:2000000

sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pageConsolidatefrom:
consolidatefrom

Consolidate the coins held at a specific address into one coin, signing with a private
key you supply.

fromaddress:
    The address whose coins are consolidated (Mx.. or 0x..).

script:
    The full KISS VM script of fromaddress, e.g. RETURN SIGNEDBY(0x..)

privatekey:
    The 0x private key seed that signs for fromaddress.

keyuses:
    How many times this private key has already signed. Every signature must use a
    fresh leaf of the key tree, so increase this by one for each signature you make.

tokenid: (optional)
    The token to consolidate. Default 0x00 (Minima).

mine: (optional)
    true or false, default true. Mine the transaction immediately.

burn: (optional)
    The amount of Minima to burn with this transaction.

maxcoins: (optional)
    Maximum number of coins to consolidate in one transaction. Default 50.

consolidatefrom fromaddress:Mx.. tokenid:0x.. script:"RETURN SIGNEDBY(0x..)" privatekey:0x.. keyuses:8 maxcoins:20

sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pageSendfrom:
sendfrom

Send Minima or tokens from one specific address, signing with a private key you supply.
The coins at fromaddress are selected, and the transaction is built, signed and posted.

Use this for addresses whose script and key you hold outside the node wallet.

fromaddress:
    The address to spend from (Mx.. or 0x..). Its coins are the inputs.

address:
    The address to send to.

amount:
    The amount to send.

script:
    The full KISS VM script of fromaddress, e.g. RETURN SIGNEDBY(0x..)

privatekey:
    The 0x private key seed that signs for fromaddress.

keyuses:
    How many times this private key has already signed. Every signature must use a
    fresh leaf of the key tree, so increase this by one for each signature you make.

tokenid: (optional)
    The token to send. Default 0x00 (Minima).

mine: (optional)
    true or false, default true. Mine the transaction immediately.

burn: (optional)
    The amount of Minima to burn with this transaction.

state: (optional)
    JSON object of state variables to add to the output: {port:value,..}

split: (optional)
    Split the sent amount into this many equal output coins. Default 1.

Examples:

sendfrom fromaddress:Mx.. address:Mx.. amount:10 script:"RETURN SIGNEDBY(0x..)" privatekey:0x.. keyuses:5

sendfrom fromaddress:0x.. address:Mx.. amount:1 tokenid:0x.. script:"RETURN SIGNEDBY(0x..)" privatekey:0x.. keyuses:6 mine:false
sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pageSignfrom:
signfrom

privatekey:

id: (optional)

post: (optional)
    true or false, default false. Post the transaction immediately after signing.

Examples:

signfrom data:0x.. privatekey:0x.. keyuses:5 post:true

sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pageSphincs:
sphincs

SPHINCS+ generate, sign and verify.

Generates a SPHINCS+ key signs messages and verifies.

action:
    generate - generate a sphincs key.
    sign - sign a piece of data.
    verify - sign a piece of data.
    transaction - send from a certain private key.
    test - run a built-in SPHINCS+ sign and verify self test.

seed:
    The seed used to generate a Key.

data:
    The data to sign / verify

file:
    The file path to save a signature to - can be the full path or relative to your base folder

privatekey:
    The SPHINCS+ private key (0x..) to sign with, or to send from with action:transaction.

publickey:
    The SPHINCS+ public key (0x..) to verify against.

signature:
    Use with action:verify. The signature (0x..) to check, if not read from file:

amount:
    Use with action:transaction. The amount to send.

address:
    Use with action:transaction. The address to send to.

tokenid:
    Use with action:transaction. The token to send.

mine:
    Use with action:transaction. true or false, default false - mine the
    transaction immediately.

Examples:

sphincs action:generate seed:mysecretseed

sphincs action:sign data:0x001122 privatekey:0x..

sphincs action:verify data:0x001122 publickey:0x.. signature:0x..|file:thefile

sphincs action:transaction privatekey:0x.. address:Mx.. tokenid:0x.. amount:10

sphincs action:test
sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.paramSphincsFile: The file path to save a signature to - can be the full path or relative to your base folder
sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pageArchive:
archive

Perform a chain or seed re-sync from an archive node or archive export file.

A chain re-sync will put your node on the correct chain.

Use a chain re-sync if your node has been offline for too long and cannot catchup. Seed Phrase is not required.

A seed re-sync will wipe the wallet, re-generate your private keys and restore your coins.

Only do a seed re-sync if you have lost your node and do not have a backup.

You can also perform checks on your archive db or archive file and check an address.

action:
    integrity : Check the integrity of your archive db. No host required.
    inspect : inspect an archive export .gzip file. If 'last:1', the file can re-sync any node from genesis.
    export : Export your archive db to a .gzip file. 
    exportraw : Export your archive db to a raw .dat file (recommended).
    resync : Use with 'host' to do a chain or seed re-sync from an archive node. 
    import : Use with 'file' to do a chain or seed re-sync using a .dat or .gzip archive file. 
    addresscheck : check your archive db for spent and unspent coins at a specific address.
    importold : Import an archive backup made by an older node version (H2 format). Use with file:
    importraw : Import a raw archive export (.raw.dat). Much faster than the H2 gzip import. Use with file:
    inspectraw : Inspect a raw archive export - its cascade and block range - without importing it. Use with file:

host: (optional) 
    ip:port of the archive node to sync from. Use with action:resync.

file: (optional) 
    name or path of the archive export gzip file to export/import/inspect.

phrase: (optional)
    To seed re-sync, enter your seed phrase in double quotes. Use with action:import or resync.
    This will replace the current seed phrase of this node. You do NOT have to do this if you still have access to your wallet.
    In this case, use action:import or resync without 'phrase' to get on the correct chain.

anyphrase: (optional)
    true or false. If you set a custom seed phrase on startup, you can set this to true. Default is false.

keys: (optional) 
    Number of keys to create if you need to do a seed re-sync. Default is 64.

keyuses: (optional) 
    How many times at most you used your keys..
    Every time you re-sync with seed phrase this needs to be higher as Minima Signatures are stateful.
    Defaults to 1000 - the max is 262144 for normal keys.

address: (optional) 
    The wallet or script address to search for in the archive. Use with action:addresscheck.
    If using a script address, also provide an address or public key in the 'statecheck' parameter.
    Use with action:addresscheck.

statecheck: (optional) 
    Data to search for in a coin's state variables.
    Combine with a script address in the 'address' parameter to search for coins locked in a contract.

logs: (optional) 
    true or false. Show detailed logs, default false.

maxexport: (optional) 
    How many blocks to export to a raw .dat file. Useful for testing purposes.

Examples:

archive action:integrity

archive action:inspect file:archiveexport-ddmmyy.gzip

archive action:exportraw file:archiveexport-ddmmyy.raw.dat

archive action:resync host:89.98.89.98:9001

archive action:import file:archiveexport-ddmmyy.raw.dat

archive action:import file:archiveexport-ddmmyy.raw.dat phrase:"YOUR 24 WORD SEED PHRASE" keyuses:2000

archive action:addresscheck address:0xFED.. statecheck:0xABC..

archive action:importraw file:archivebackup.raw.dat

archive action:inspectraw file:archivebackup.raw.dat
sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.paramArchiveKeyuses: How many times at most you used your keys..
sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pageMegammrsync:
megammrsync

Perform a chain or seed re-sync from a MegaMMR node. Fast.

If you are on the wrong chain - all you need to provide is the 'host' to connect to.

If you are on a fresh node, with different seed phrase, provide 'host' and 'phrase' to resync with that Wallet.

You can load an old backup and resync to the chain tip aswell.

The host you connect to MUST be running with -megammr.

action:
    mydetails : Shows which addresses and public keys you are searching for.
    resync : Perform the actual MegaMMR resync.

host:
    ip:port of the node to sync from. Use with action:resync.

phrase: (optional)
    To seed re-sync, enter your seed phrase in double quotes. Use with action:resync.
    This will replace the current seed phrase of this node. You do NOT have to do this if you still have access to your wallet.

anyphrase: (optional)
    true or false. If you set a custom seed phrase on startup, you can set this to true. Default is false.

keys: (optional) 
    Number of keys to create if you need to do a seed re-sync. Default is 64.

keyuses: (optional) 
    How many times at most you used your keys..
    Every time you re-sync with seed phrase this needs to be higher as Minima Signatures are stateful.
    Defaults to 1000 - the max is 262144 for normal keys.

file: (optional)
    Specify the filename or local path of the backup to restore

password: (optional)
    Enter the password of the backup 


Examples:

megammrsync action:mydetails

megammrsync action:resync host:98.65.45.34:9001

megammrsync action:resync host:98.65.45.34:9001 file:myoldbakup.bak password:backup_password

megammrsync action:resync host:98.65.45.34:9001 phrase:"YOUR 24 WORD SEED PHRASE" keyuses:2000
sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pageMultisigread:
multisigread

Utility Function for multisig in READ mode
List, create a spend or get a key for a nultisig coin that can only be used in a txn signed by root OR n of m given public keys.

action: 
    getkey : returns one of your default public keys to be provided when creating the coin.
    list : lists all existing multisig coins.
    spend : creates an unsigned transaction (.txn) file to spend a specified amount of a multisig coin.
    post : posts the transaction to the network, must be signed as required by the contract before posting.
    view : view the details of a multisig transaction file.

id: (optional)
    Create a multisig coin with an id or list by id.
    Should be unique. This cannot be retrieved later.
    The id is hashed and stored as state variable 0.

amount: (optional)
    The amount to lock in the multisig coin or the amount to spend.

coinid: (optional)
    The coinid of the multisig coin to spend. Alternatively, use the id.

address: (optional)
    The address to send the specified amount to.

file: (optional)
    The transaction (.txn) file to view or post.

root: (optional)
    Accepted for parity with multisig. Not used by multisigread.

required: (optional)
    Accepted for parity with multisig. Not used by multisigread.

publickeys: (optional)
    Accepted for parity with multisig. Not used by multisigread.

tokenid: (optional)
    Accepted for parity with multisig. Not used by multisigread.

password: (optional)
    Accepted for parity with multisig. Not used by multisigread.

Examples:

multisig action:getkey

multisig action:list

sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pageMysql:
mysql

Export archive data to a MySQL server.

The MySQL db can be used to perform a chain re-sync to put users on the correct chain,

or a seed re-sync to restore access to lost funds, using the seed phrase.

Can query an address for its history of spent and unspent coins.

Additionally export the MySQL db to a gzip file for resyncing with 'reset' or 'archive' command.

You can use setlogin to auto set the login details
host:
    The ip:port (or name of Docker container) running the MySQL db.

database:
    name of the MySQL db being used to store the archive db data.

user:
    MySQL user to login to as.

password:
    MySQL password for the user provided.

readonly:
    true or false, Connect in readonly mode.
logs:
    Show detailed logs - default true.

action:
    info : Show the blocks stored in the archive db and compare to the MySQL db.
    integrity : Check the block order and block parents are correct in the MySQL db.
    update : Update the MySQL db with the latest syncblocks from the node's archive db.
    addresscheck : Check the history of all the spent and unspent coins from an address.
    setlogin : Set the MySQL login details so you don't need to type them in every time.
    clearlogin : Clear MySQL login details.
    autobackup : Automatically save archive data to MySQL DB. Use with enable. Also stores all TxPoW the node sees.
    findtxpow : Search for an individual TxPoW (only works if autobackup is enabled).
    resync : Perform a chain or seed re-sync from the specified MySQL db.
             Will shutdown the node so you must restart it once complete.
    wipe :  Be careful. Wipe the MySQL db.
    h2export : export the MySQL db to an archive gzip file which can be used to resync a node.
    h2import : import an archive gzip file to the MySQL db.
    rawexport : export the MySQL db to raw.dat file which can be used to resync a node (faster than H2).
    rawimport : import a raw.dat to the MySQL db.
    size : Show the number of blocks stored in the MySQL db.
    reset : Import a raw .dat archive file (file:) into the MySQL db, then re-sync the node from it.
    fixmissing : Scan a raw archive file (file:) and insert any blocks missing from the MySQL db. Use startfix: to skip ahead.

phrase: (optional)
     Use with action:resync. The 24 word seed phrase of the node to re-sync.
     If provided, the node will be wiped and re-synced.
     If not provided, the node will be re-synced to the chain and will not be wiped.

keys: (optional)
    If the seed phrase is provided, optionally set the number of keys to create.
    Default is 80.

keyuses: (optional)
    If the seed phrase is provided, optionally set the number of previous uses for each key created.
    Default is 1000.

address: (optional)
    Use with action:addresscheck. The address to check the history of spent and unspent coins for.

enable: (optional)
    Use with action:autobackup. Automatically save data to MySQL archive DB.

file: (optional)
    Name or path of the archive gzip file to export to or import from.

txpowid: (optional)
    Use with action:findtxpow. The TxPoW id to look up.

statecheck: (optional)
    Use with action:addresscheck. Only include coins whose state variables contain this value.

maxexport: (optional)
    Use with action:rawexport. Maximum number of blocks to export.

startfix: (optional)
    Use with action:fixmissing. The block number to start checking from.

endfix: (optional)
    Accepted but currently unused.

block: (optional)
    Use with action:findtxpow. Look up the block at this block number instead of a TxPoW id.

Examples:

mysql ..LOGIN_DETAILS.. action:setlogin

mysql host:mysqlhost:port database:archivedb user:archiveuser password:archivepassword action:info

mysql host:dockermysql database:archivedb user:archiveuser password:archivepassword action:info

mysql (If you have not setlogin)..LOGIN_DETAILS.. action:integrity

mysql action:update

mysql action:addresscheck address:MxG08.. 

mysql action:resync

mysql action:findtxpow txpowid:0x00FFEEDD..

mysql action:resync phrase:"24 WORDS HERE" keys:90 keyuses:2000

mysql action:rawexport file:archivexport-DDMMYY.gzip

mysql action:size

mysql action:findtxpow block:12345

mysql action:addresscheck address:MxG08.. statecheck:0xFFEEDD..

mysql action:fixmissing file:archivebackup.raw.dat startfix:100000

sourceOverrides.terminalHelp.pageMysqlcoins:
mysqlcoins

Create a coins db from your mysql data and search it.

Use the same database you already use for your TxBlocks. Just creates a new table.

You can use setlogin in mysql function to auto set the login details
host:
    The ip:port (or name of Docker container) running the MySQL db.

database:
    name of the MySQL db being used to store the archive db data.

user:
    MySQL user to login to as.

password:
    MySQL password for the user provided.

readonly:
    true or false, Connect in readonly mode.
logs:
    Show detailed logs - default false.

where:
    The search criteria. String data MUST be in single quotes. You can use multiple parameters.

maxcoins:
    The maximum numnber of coins to add. The update can take a VERY long time so this way you can limit it.

action:
    info : Get information about the Coins DB.
    wipe : Wipe the Coins DB.
    update : Update the coins db from the latest coin added with MySQL data.
    search : Perform a search on the data. You can specify any valid query param or do a specific address check.
           Other params :
           query:the full sql query
    autobackup : Automatically keep the coins db updated. Use with enable:true|false.

           address:the address to check for
           spent:true/false
           limit:limit the number of rows returned

query:
    Use with action:search. A complete SQL query to run against the coins table.

maxblocks:
    Use with action:update. Maximum number of blocks to process. Default unlimited.

hidetoken:
    true or false, default false. Use with action:search. Omit the token details
    from each coin returned.

address:
    Use with action:search. Return the coins at this address, or with it in their state.

spent:
    true or false. Use with action:search address:. Only spent, or only unspent, coins.

limit:
    Use with action:search address:. Maximum number of rows to return.

enable:
    true or false. Use with action:autobackup.

Examples:

mysqlcoins host:127.0.0.1:3306 database:coinsdb user:myuser password:myuser action:update maxcoins:100

mysqlcoins (If you have not setlogin in mysql function)..LOGIN_DETAILS.. action:search where:"address='0x791E78C60652B0E19B8FE9EB035B122B261490C477FD76E38C0C928187076103'"

mysqlcoins action:search where:"address='0x791E78C60652B0E19B8FE9EB035B122B261490C477FD76E38C0C928187076103' spent:false limit:1"

mysqlcoins action:search address:Mx87DE..

mysqlcoins action:search query:"address='0x791E78C60652B0E19B8FE9EB035B122B261490C477FD76E38C0C928187076103' AND state LIKE '%0xFFEEDD%' LIMIT 10"

mysqlcoins action:autobackup enable:true

mysqlcoins action:search address:Mx87DE.. spent:false limit:10 hidetoken:true
